integrity: The threshold follows by exact inversion of the two-state Cayley resolvent and an M-matrix identity valid in all dimensions. The published determinant-only implication is tested by an exact diagonal counterexample. The embedded verifier uses rational arithmetic for counterexamples, boundary cases, and representative identities; finite checks are not used as proof of the universal theorem.
scientific_limitations: Closed-form threshold is for real two-state Hurwitz Metzler systems and first-order diagonal Pade/Tustin discretization. In higher dimensions an exact resolvent-diagonal criterion is proved but not reduced to a simple entrywise formula. Higher Pade orders, nonautonomous systems, nonlinear positive systems, and floating-point robustness are outside scope.
title: Exact two-state Tustin positivity threshold and a correction to a published determinant test
